messages:
clare: Hey team — prepping social launch posts tomorrow, need a tiny reproducible bench pack we can attach to the post. Lightweight: 50 sample prompts, 3 runs each, call out cold vs warm and quantized vs fp16. Can eng/runtime do this by EOD? @aj @sam :pray:
aj: We can. Quick Qs: do you want the exact payloads + seed, or just aggregated percentiles and a gist of raw samples?
clare: Ideally both — a short CSV of samples + seeds, and a one-pager with median/p95 and a note on methodology. We want to say "samples available for repro" not publish full dataset. @katie-mkt wants a couple of representative responses for the tweet.
sam: OK. Plan: use the current live model v2.3 quantized build and fp16 build. Warm runs: first 20 tokens pre-warmed, cold runs: fresh process. Will run 3 full sweeps (50 prompts x 3) for each variant. Will produce: artifacts.tar.gz (payloads, seeds, raw outputs), metrics.json (median/p95/mean token-latency), and a 1-page markdown methodology.
devon: Addtional note — we should include system prompt + max_tokens + temperature. Also will capture GPU memory & infra tag (node image) for reproducibility.
clare: Perfect. For the one-pager please include short headline copy we can paste: 2 lines on what the numbers represent + caveat about variance. Katie wants a single representative response that looks "on-brand."
katie-mkt: I can pick the response once you upload artifacts. If you can tag 3 candidate outputs in the gist that'd help. :sparkles:
perf-bot: Scheduled job queued: bench-lite/3367891234 started by @sam — variants: [quantized, fp16], samples:50, runs:3, capture:gpu-stats, logs:true.
aj: Small technical ask — do you want prefix/KV-cache enabled? For social claims we usually report with caching disabled to reflect cold-call behavior, but we can show both.
clare: Show both. Call out which line is the cold/cached number in the table. Keep copy simple.
sam: Cool — will push artifacts to s3://redwood-marketing/launch-pack/3367891234/ and post link in this thread when done (ETA 5 hours). If we hit infra flakiness we'll rerun and annotate.
clare: Thank you! If anything blocks, ping me. Will draft tweet copy once I see representative outputs. :rocket:
